function: Implicit CSI feedback: autoencoder EVCsiNet compresses the eigenvector precoding matrix at the UE and reconstructs it at the BS, trained on digital-twin channels and fine-tuned online (p. 2).
system: Single-user MIMO, 8-patch antennas at BS and UE, 5G NR OFDM at 3.8 GHz, 100 MHz, 1,620 subcarriers, Ns = 2 streams; indoor corridor; no RIS (p. 3).
method: EVCsiNet autoencoder with MSE reconstruction loss; pretrained on digital-twin channels, then decoder-only fine-tuning (online learning) at the BS with real-world data (pp. 2-3).
data_channel: Training: Wireless InSite ray-traced indoor DT of NSYSU corridor (also outdoor DT; CDL TR 38.901 baseline). Testing/fine-tuning: own RW measurements, 78 points x 200, 3.8 GHz (pp. 3-4).
test_conditions: Trained on indoor DT; tested on real-world data with and without OL on 30% of RW points, and on changed BS antenna pattern with 5% OL (pp. 4-5).
baselines: Type II codebook (2, 3, 4 beams; non-learned); learned: EVCsiNet trained on outdoor DT and on 3GPP CDL; perfect and non-precoded throughput references (pp. 4-5).
metrics: Cosine similarity of the precoder, throughput in Mbps, feedback overhead in bits (pp. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 3: "RW measurements were conducted in an indoor corridor" - the real-world measured channels (78 points, 200 measurements each) are used for online learning and for testing; pre-training uses custom Wireless InSite ray tracing.
q2_support: p. 5: "Incorporating 5% of new BS antenna data into OL restores" - the model trained on DT data is tested on real-world data (p. 4, Table II) and on a changed BS antenna pattern, with small-data adaptation.
q3_support: p. 4: "and CDL EVCsiNet, the baseline" - the non-learned Type II codebook is compared, but the only learned baselines are the same EVCsiNet architecture trained on outdoor DT or CDL data, i.e. variants of the proposed pipeline, not an earlier independent learned method.
q4_support: p. 2: "designed for reduced computational complexity and latency" - only a qualitative statement; no FLOPs, parameters, runtime or complexity order is reported; the feedback bits are signaling overhead only.
q5_support: p. 1: "We construct a comprehensive dataset that includes RW" - the model is fine-tuned and tested on its own measured data; no code or data link or DOI is given, so the mark rests only on the measured-data clause.
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI (AI-Based CSI Feedback With Digital Twins: Real-World Validation and Insights). Area 2 (implicit CSI feedback). q1 and q5 rest on the own real-world measurement campaign (not released); the digital twin is a custom Wireless InSite ray-tracing replica, not DeepMIMO. q3 is borderline: CDL EVCsiNet is EVCsiNet of [5] trained on 3GPP CDL, but the paper adopts the same architecture, so it is read as the same method trained on other data; the reviewer should confirm.
